name: Primary Button
accessibility: Renders as a real <button> element, so it's reachable by keyboard (Tab) and activates with Enter/Space by default - no extra ARIA role needed.
Focus state uses a visible 2px outline, never a color-only change, so keyboard users can always tell which control is focused.
Disabled buttons use the native disabled attribute (removed from the tab order and announced as unavailable by screen readers), not just a visual dim.

source.notes: Rendered snapshot of the selected appearance, with State, Size and Corner radius captured as crossed properties (State, Size, Corner radius) - every combination draws as its own Figma variant. Content (icon placement) is exposed as independent Boolean properties and the label as a Text property, rather than crossed, to stay inside Figma’s 256-variant-per-set limit. This JSON/prompt export is this one appearance only; clicking Draw in Figma instead gathers every Button appearance page and pushes one merged "Button" component with an Appearance property switching between them, each appearance keeping its own full State/Size/Corner radius set underneath. Native property IDs retain canonical values; anatomy styles and tokens use context.unit.
